name: Moonglade
summary: A druid teacher offers you a way to reach Moonglade and meet Dendrite Starblaze. There, you can speak with him about the path you have begun.

sections.title: A First Lesson
sections.body: Your teacher welcomes all druids to Moonglade, where Keeper Remulos watches over those who rest there. You receive the spell Teleport: Moonglade, which lets you travel there when you seek its knowledge or solace. Your first lesson is to speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you are now on.

sections.title: The Bear Form
sections.body: Dendrite recognizes that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. He sees you as well on your way.

faq.q: Who should I speak to in Moonglade?
faq.answer: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven about the path you are on.

faq.q: How do I get to Moonglade?
faq.answer: Your teacher gives you the spell Teleport: Moonglade, which transports you there.

faq.q: Who watches over druids in Moonglade?
faq.answer: Keeper Remulos is Moonglade's guardian and watches over druids who rest there.

faq.q: What does Dendrite say about my progress?
faq.answer: Dendrite recognizes that you have already mastered the form of the Bear.

angles.text: As a druid, your teacher welcomes you to Moonglade and teaches you a spell to travel there.
